title: Operator norm is bounded by the Hilbert-Schmidt norm
statement: For all natural numbers m, k and every continuous linear map A from the Euclidean space R^m (Rn m) to R^k (Rn k), the operator norm satisfies ||A|| <= hsNorm A, where hsNorm A = sqrt(sum over i < m of |A e_i|^2) and e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 is the i-th standard basis vector.
lean_statement: ∀ {m k : ℕ} (A : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k), ‖A‖ ≤ hsNorm A
